jobs.title: Director, Strategic Partnerships
jobs.description:
About VGS
VGS is building the trust infrastructure for a new era of commerce. As commerce becomes agentic, payments are increasing dramatically in volume, speed, and complexity, and the companies driving that shift need a foundation they can fully trust.

That's where VGS comes in. We're the world's leader in payment tokenization, trusted by the most innovative AI and Fortune 500 companies, merchants, banks, and fintechs to power modern payments and agentic commerce. We store more than 9 billion tokens and process more than 10 billion monthly interactions, touching a third of all e-commerce. That scale isn't incidental. It's why leading companies embed our universal token vault and credential management platform directly into their stack, taming the complexity of payment data so they can move faster.

Come build the platform that enables modern payments for the world's largest companies. We're helping businesses unlock new possibilities in an industry that never stops moving. And that takes exceptional people.
 

 
About the Role
The Director, Strategic Partnerships – Payments & Product will lead the expansion of VGS's strategic partner ecosystem - building relationships with card networks, investors, cloud providers, and emerging payments infrastructure players that directly shape our product strategy and platform capabilities.
 
This role blends external partner engagement with internal product collaboration. You’ll help shape our product roadmap by bringing ecosystem insights and partnership-led opportunities to life - whether through expanding our card network services, accelerating agentic tokens, or other innovative initiatives.
 

 
What You'll Do
Lead and develop a team of Strategic Partnerships professionals, including direct reports, setting clear priorities, coaching performance, and building the team’s capabilities as VGS’s partnership portfolio and strategic mandate expand.
Own and grow a portfolio of VGS’s most strategic partnerships across payments and commerce technology, including card networks, investors, cloud and infrastructure providers, AI platforms, wallets, processors, and other ecosystem partners.
Develop and execute partnership strategies that advance VGS’s company and product priorities, identifying where external partners can accelerate growth, strengthen product differentiation, or open new markets and distribution channels.
Lead complex, product-oriented partnerships that require deep coordination across Product, Engineering, Legal, Sales, and Executive Leadership, translating strategic opportunities into executable commercial and technical plans.
Source, evaluate, prioritize, and develop new strategic partnerships, with a focus on opportunities that can materially influence VGS’s product roadmap, competitive positioning, or long-term growth.
Lead negotiations for strategic commercial and product agreements, including defining partnership structures, economics, go-to-market models, technical commitments, and mutual success criteria.
Drive partnerships from initial strategy and business case through negotiation, launch, commercialization, and ongoing relationship management.
Build senior-level relationships with partner executives and serve as a trusted strategic counterpart, identifying opportunities to expand the partnership and proactively addressing risks or areas of misalignment.
Establish clear goals, operating rhythms, and success metrics for key partnerships, holding both VGS and partners accountable for execution and measurable outcomes.
Act as the voice of strategic partners within VGS, bringing external market insights, partner priorities, and ecosystem developments into product and company decision-making.
Influence VGS’s broader corporate and product strategy by developing a point of view on the evolution of tokenization, payments infrastructure, agentic commerce, AI, and next-generation commerce technologies.
Identify emerging ecosystem shifts and translate them into actionable recommendations for VGS, including potential new products, partnerships, distribution models, and strategic initiatives.
Represent VGS externally with senior leaders across the payments and technology ecosystem, strengthening VGS’s position as a strategic infrastructure partner for the next generation of commerce.
 
 

 
What You Bring
10+ years of experience in strategic partnerships, fintech BD, product strategy, or payments consulting
Understanding of the payments ecosystem—issuers, processors, card networks, wallets, and commerce platforms
Ability to connect technical product functionality with partner and market needs
Demonstrated success managing complex partnerships and cross-functional projects
Comfortable in ambiguous, fast-paced environments with shifting priorities and emerging technologies
Strong written and verbal communication skills, with a strategic mindset and a bias toward execution

Nice to Have:
Experience with tokenization, payment processing, cryptology, or security products
BA/BS degree
A knack for out-of-the-box thinking that thrives in a fast-paced startup environment
Experience working closely with product or engineering teams in a platform company or fintech infrastructure provider, especially in an innovative and fast paced startup environment
Familiarity with tokenization, payment flows, reconciliation processes, or data compliance frameworks
Technical literacy (e.g., comfortable discussing APIs, SDKs, and integration workflows)
 

 

 

 
How We Work
At VGS, we embrace a remote-first philosophy because we believe flexibility leads to great work and a healthy work-life balance. That said, if you live within 30 miles of one of our office locations, you'll be on a hybrid schedule with some in-person time, because we know there's real value in coming together.

We're not about being in the office every day. We are about connection, collaboration, and the energy that comes from a great brainstorm, a team lunch, or celebrating a big win in person.
 

 
Our Benefits
Financial and retirement
Competitive salary
401(k) with a 4% match and immediate vesting (applies to US only)
Early equity
Internet stipend
Learning stipend
Office set-up stipend (applies to US only)
 
Health and Wellness
Insurance (medical, dental, and vision)
HSA/FSA options
Life and disability insurance
Pet insurance
 
Vacation and time off
Flexible PTO
Paid national holidays
Global parental leave program
 
Professional Development
Promote from within
Lunch and learns
Team events and summits
 
Office life and perks
Remote and hybrid opportunities
Flexible working hours
Weekly office lunches
Employee discount platform
 

 
Equal Opportunity
We consider all applicants without regard to race, color, national origin, sex, age, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran status, marital status, physical or mental disability, or other protected classes under all applicable local, state, and federal laws and ordinances (AA/EOE/W/M/Vet/Disabled).
Qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records will be considered for this position in accordance with the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance.
 

 
Where We're Hiring
We are currently hiring in the following locations: Arizona, California, Colorado, Connecticut, Florida, Idaho, Illinois, Iowa, Michigan, Minnesota, New York, North Carolina, Ohio, Oregon, Pennsylvania, Texas, Utah, Virginia, Washington, Ontario (Canada), Alberta (Canada), and British Columbia (Canada).
 

 
A Note on Our Hiring Process

jobs.title: Senior HR Business Partner
jobs.description:
VGS is the world's leader in payment tokenization.  Large banks, aspiring fintechs, and growing merchants embed our universal token vault into their technology stack to manage the complexities of payment data tokenization across processors and networks, open banking, card issuance, omnichannel loyalty, PCI compliance, payment orchestration, and more. We empower our clients and partners by tokenizing sensitive payment data, limiting compliance scope, and consolidating payments to unlock revenue and business opportunities. 
VGS provides processor-agnostic tokenization solutions via secure universal token vaults, iframes, mobile SDKs, tokenization proxies, APIs, and data orchestration tooling to support payment acceptance, card issuance, PII and bank account tokenization, and other payments value-added services. Some of the use cases we enable include multi-processor Network Tokenization, Account Updater, payment orchestration, secure settlement file processing, 3DS, and Risk provider connectivity.
VGS is looking for a Senior HR Business Partner who can pair trusted counsel with hands-on execution. You will support leaders and employees across technical and business functions, translate business priorities into practical people plans, and help VGS build healthy, accountable teams through change and growth.
This is a broad generalist role for an experienced partner who is equally comfortable advising a leader on organization design, coaching a manager through a difficult performance conversation, reviewing people data, and driving a people program to completion. You will support Engineering, Product, Infrastructure, Go-to-Market, or other technical teams in a scaling technology company.
We are prioritizing candidates based in the Bay Area to support in-person partnership with leadership teams.

What you will be doing at VGS (Responsibilities)...
-
Business partnership and organization effectiveness. Build a deep understanding of assigned teams, their goals, and their operating context. Advise leaders on organization design, role clarity, team effectiveness, workforce planning, spans and layers, and talent priorities.

-
Manager coaching and employee relations. Serve as a first point of contact for managers and employees. Coach leaders through performance, feedback, conflict, attendance, accommodations, leaves, conduct, and workplace concerns; conduct or support fair, timely investigations; and partner with Legal or outside counsel when appropriate.

-
Performance and talent management. Lead the business-facing work for performance reviews, goal setting, talent reviews, succession planning, development planning, promotions, and corrective action. Help managers raise the quality and consistency of feedback and talent decisions.

-
Compensation and leveling. Partner with People leadership and Finance on compensation planning, job leveling, pay decisions, promotions, and retention actions. Apply established frameworks consistently and identify where clearer guidance or calibration is needed.

-
Organizational change. Plan and execute reorganizations, leadership transitions, and other changes with sound judgment, clear communication, careful documentation, and respect for the employee experience. Support compliant and well-coordinated offboarding and termination processes.

-
Employee experience and culture. Maintain an intentional listening cadence through employee check-ins, office hours, focus groups, and targeted outreach. Surface themes, distinguish individual concerns from systemic issues, and partner with leaders on practical actions.

-
People programs and operations. Translate company-wide programs and policies into effective execution within the business. Partner with People Operations and Recruiting across hiring, onboarding, engagement, mobility, leaves, and offboarding; improve processes where ownership or handoffs are unclear.

-
Insights and risk management. Use workforce data and qualitative signals to identify trends in attrition, engagement, performance, manager effectiveness, and organizational health. Provide leaders with clear recommendations while maintaining accurate, confidential case documentation and consistent practices.
What we are looking for from you (Requirements)...
-
7+ years of progressive HR experience, including substantial experience in an HRBP, People Partner, or broad HR generalist role supporting leaders and employees.

-
Demonstrated success advising senior leaders and coaching managers through complex employee relations, performance, organizational, and talent decisions.

-
Working knowledge of California and multi-state U.S. employment practices, with the judgment to recognize when specialized legal guidance is needed.

-
Experience owning or materially contributing to core people cycles such as performance reviews, compensation planning, promotions, talent reviews, engagement, and workforce planning.

-
Strong business acumen and analytical skill; able to connect people data and employee feedback to operating priorities and concrete recommendations.

-
Excellent written and verbal communication, strong facilitation skills, and the ability to adapt your approach across employees, managers, and executives.

-
Sound judgment, discretion, and consistency when handling sensitive information and high-stakes decisions.

-
A practical, low-ego operating style: organized, responsive, comfortable with ambiguity, and willing to move between strategic advice and detailed execution.

-
Exposure to workforce planning and headcount management processes
How success will be measured
-
Leaders receive timely, clear, and business-grounded advice—and become more capable people managers over time.

-
Employee matters are handled consistently, respectfully, and with appropriate urgency, documentation, and follow-through.

-
Talent, performance, compensation, and organizational decisions are better calibrated and supported by useful data and clear frameworks.

-
People programs land effectively within supported teams, with strong cross-functional coordination and fewer ownership gaps.

-
Emerging organizational risks and employee themes are identified early and translated into practical action.
What you get from us… 
Flexible work hours and flexible PTO
Competitive health benefits
VGS stock options
401k plan, with employer matching 4% and immediate vesting (available only for US employees)
Life & disability insurance
Pre-tax flexible spending accounts, dependent and healthcare FSA (available only for US employees)
Global parental leave program
Employee Assistance Program
Home Internet reimbursement
New hire home office set-up allowance
Professional learning reimbursement
 
At VGS, we have a remote-first philosophy because we believe flexibility leads to great work and a healthy work-life balance. That said, if you live within 30 miles of one of our office locations, you’ll be on a hybrid schedule with some in-person time—because we know there’s real value in coming together.
 We’re not about being in the office every day—but we are about connection, collaboration, and the energy that comes from a great brainstorm, a team lunch, or celebrating a big win in person.

Qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records will be considered for the position in accordance with the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance.
Visa Sponsorship. The Company does not provide visa sponsorship for this role. Candidates must be legally authorized to work in the United States at the time of hire and throughout their employment. Individuals with temporary visas such as E, F-1 (including those with OPT or CPT), H-1, H-2, L-1, B, J, or TN, or who need sponsorship for work authorization now or in the future, are not eligible.
